explication: LocalRecall is a REST service and client library for managing RAG collections, plus a separate PostgreSQL-only API for caller-supplied vectors. The principal workflow is a client request to the API, which manages collections and retrieval; files can also be added and searched through the web UI. External sources are fetched by a background source manager. The README documents Chromem and PostgreSQL engines, embedding integrations, and hybrid search. Some routing and persistence implementation details were not sampled, so uncertain links are omitted.
